brief.prompt:
Create ONE finished editorial thumbnail for the Japanese basketball website バスケまとめ. Brand-new original hand-drawn illustration. Landscape 16:9, ideally 2048 x 1152, minimum width 1000. Opaque PNG.

STYLE:
Match the inspected approved B-culver-black-lime-v3 style: deep near-black #151A18 background, energetic acid-lime #CCF43B brush swashes, ivory bold Japanese type, expressive hand ink and dry-brush hatching, screenprint textures, spare strong composition. Visibly drawn, NOT photorealistic, NOT a photographic collage. Orange basketball as small prop only. No team or league logos, sponsors, brand marks, jersey text or numbers.

SUBJECTS:
Draw exactly TWO real identifiable basketball players: Jordan Faison (ジョーダン・フェイゾン, Tokyo United) and Jayden Gardner (ジェイデン・ガードナー, Shizuoka). Their official portrait references were just inspected in this conversation. Use the likeness specifics below faithfully, not a generic or fictional player.
Faison official reference: https://bleague.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=2026102817/files/user/roster/2725/2026-27/12648_01.jpg
Faison: tall powerful broad-shouldered build; extremely close shaved dark hair exposing high rounded forehead; elongated oval face and tapered jaw; neatly shaped dense full black beard continuing under chin and jaw, short mustache; dark almond eyes, straight brows, medium broad nose, full lips. Plain pale/ivory basketball uniform with dark edging, no printed details.
Gardner official reference: https://veltex.bl.kuroco-img.app/files/user/team/players/ID_01_5.png?v=1789526389
Gardner: tall muscular broad neck and shoulders; voluminous upright short black coiled twists, noticeably much taller hair than Faison and tapered sides; broad squarish oval face, full cheeks, dark wide-set eyes, full lips, broad nose; thin mustache and short close-trimmed beard concentrated on chin and jaw. Plain dark uniform with subtle lime edging, no printed details.
Render skin through warm grey/ivory and black ink hatching, recognisable facial structure without photo texture.

SCENE AND COMPOSITION:
On the RIGHT 52% of the canvas draw a dynamic one-on-one basketball matchup illustration, three-quarter view from around knee level upward. Gardner lower in the foreground driving with a low dribble, his right hand contacting the top of one orange ball; Faison behind/opposite him in a bent-knee defensive stance with an open hand and a clearly visible face. Both faces visible in three-quarter views, hairlines and beards readable, anatomically coherent two arms per person, hands and fingers natural, no merged limbs. Keep heads, hands, and the basketball fully inside the canvas. Lower legs may naturally end at lower illustration boundary. Strong diagonal lime dry-brush strokes communicate motion, no crowds or extra people, no hoop necessary. This is a conceptual imagined matchup, not a recreation of any real game moment. Use NO score, NO player names, NO player stats. The two players were randomly selected from the fixed article's named players; neither is asserted to have played or excelled.

TEXT:
Keep the LEFT 48% clean for prominent exact Japanese lettering. Refined bold condensed Japanese sans-serif; giant high contrast headline; generous safe margins of 5%. Text and artwork must not collide. Draw ONLY the following exact text, each string once:
Top small: "バスケまとめ"
Date below: "2026.10.29"
Upper headline in ivory: "東京U×静岡"
Main line in ivory: "試合前"
Largest main line in lime: "EFF比較"
Smaller supporting line: "登録選手の今季平均／独自分析"
Bottom qualifier, clearly legible: "出場・勝敗の予測ではありません"
Footer on a calm dark strip across the bottom, clearly legible: "イラスト（AI生成）"
Footer companion text: "イメージ"

Maintain hierarchy: matchup → pregame EFF comparison → qualifier. Do not add further writing. Preserve the exact spelling, numbers and Japanese characters. No named-player captions, no score, no ranking, no assertion of participation, no performance number. Produce one polished complete thumbnail only.

generator.postprocessing: なし。検品合格した元PNGをbyte一致でコピー。
generator.qa_method: 生成結果の実画像を目視。文字・日付・留保・公式参照との顔の特徴・手の形・見切れ・余白・AI表記を確認。背景黒とライム、2人のプレーイメージ、ロゴ・スポンサー・実写写真なし。
